# Code of Conduct

Dream Invoice uses a simple contribution standard: be respectful, precise, and constructive.

## Expected Behavior

- Communicate with patience and clarity
- Keep feedback focused on the work
- Respect different experience levels
- Protect credentials and operational information
- Use fictional data in examples and screenshots

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, insults, threats, or personal attacks
- Publishing credentials or sensitive operational data
- Sharing sensitive operational data in discussions
- Spam or repeated off-topic comments

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, hide, or remove comments and contributions that violate this standard. Repeated violations can lead to blocked participation.

## Contact

For behavior concerns, contact the repository owner or maintainer.
